label: microscopy
definition: Imaging of a specimen at magnification using a microscope.

label: light-sheet microscopy
definition: Fluorescence microscopy in which the sample is illuminated from the side by a thin sheet of light, so that only the focal plane is excited, and imaged through a detection objective perpendicular to the sheet.
synonyms: light sheet fluorescence microscopy|LSFM|selective plane illumination microscopy|SPIM

label: high content microscopy
definition: Automated microscopy of many samples, typically in multi-well plates, combined with quantitative image analysis that extracts many measurements per cell or sample.
